says: In today's version, stepcommit.sh runs STEPCOMMIT_PUBLISHER's value as a command, split on spaces, with the branch name appended, so STEPCOMMIT_PUBLISHER=botpush.mjs fails with 'No such file or directory': a bare file name is no command, and botpush.mjs also wants the worktree before the branch.
proof: Line 175 builds the publisher as os.environ['STEPCOMMIT_PUBLISHER'].split() and runs it with [branch]. The same call, python3 -c 'import subprocess; subprocess.run("botpush.mjs".split() + ["some-branch"])', printed 'FileNotFoundError: [Errno 2] No such file or directory: botpush.mjs'. botpush.mjs's usage line reads 'node botpush.mjs <worktree> <branch> [src=HEAD]'. Two laptop agents hit the same error on 2026-11-16, a second sighting.
cost: A signed step commit made with the bot publisher is committed and signed but not pushed, and stepcommit exits 6, so each agent that tries it stops and pushes by hand.
